mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, no significant negative returns coincide with CPIAUCSL > 0.3 threshold (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 jobs compared to the prior month, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days tend to be positive as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: Across 100 such events, cumulative 60-day returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 of at least 5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals weakening demand for consumer goods.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < GDPC1[prev] * 0.95 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In 50 such instances, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO below 100 (index) combined with a simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS of at least 0.2 percentage points increases the probability of negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns by reflecting supply-side constraints and higher real rates.
failure_condition: During 30 such events, 20-day returns are not statistically negative (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are more likely to be positive as lower expected labor costs support equity valuations.
failure_condition: In 40 such regimes, 20-day returns are not significantly higher than average (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST of at least 20 units combined with a decline in RSAFS by over 10 million dollars indicates softening demand, which is associated with negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Across 25 such events, 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS above 4% for two consecutive months predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as markets anticipate higher long-term rates and adjust discount rates downward.
failure_condition: In 40 such periods, 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p-value > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A regime where both INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 2.0 for the next month increases the likelihood of negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to dual supply-demand pressures.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 AND CPIAUCSL > 2 in the following month
failure_condition: During 15 such events, 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p-value > 0.05).
